query:
The group settled on a formal protocol for logging parking incidents and a five-incidents-per-month escalation threshold. One member's response in that moment was distinctly different from the others'. Whose reaction signalled less than full agreement, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Constance
B. Walter
C. Mei
D. Henry
context:
[1] (about=Walter, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T18:47:00) Members: the structure mirrors what we used in 1998 at the firm for low-level disputes. It worked then. I have one suggested amendment, will send by email.
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T19:12:00) Right then. Proposal: we maintain a formal complaint log, Walter to keep it. We send a written escalation to the owner if there are five incidents in a calendar month. Henry to draft the protocol. Anyone object? D
[3] (about=Aisling, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:19:00) ✨ what if we did a small write-up for the residents' association website about the corner protocol? would be a nice case study tbh
[4] (about=Bex, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T18:52:00) ok i actually have a question about the protocol, what counts as an incident specifically? like is it just blocking driveways or is it any guest car parked overnight? i want to log mine properly
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t4 @2025-03-17T19:03:00) Proposal accepted: formal complaint log maintained by Walter; escalation to owner after five incidents in a calendar month; Henry to draft protocol.
[6] (about=Greg, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:10:00) marek you'd say that. mate the issue is the cars not the people right
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Henry, group-interaction, t4 @2025-03-17T19:03:00) Three incidents recorded since note went, two before owner received it.
[8] (about=Mei, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:20:00) I was thinking maybe we could include a small map showing where the residents' driveways are. Would help any new visitors.
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:55:00) I'd suggest we don't speculate on numberplates in the chat. Best to record without naming specific cars in writing.
[10] (about=Owen, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T18:51:00) I would also propose we keep a brief written record of any incidents, in case the conversation escalates. We should be careful that we have facts to refer to.
[11] (about=Priya, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:22:00) A quick note on facts: there are three driveways on the corner stretch. Two have visible signage, one does not. The one without is Reggie's.
[12] (about=Reggie, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T19:04:00) still parked across mine sat. signs wont fix manners
[13] (about=Tomás, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:11:00) Agreed. Cars across driveways is the main thing.
[14] (about=Walter, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:01:00) Three formal incidents logged. Reggie's transit van will make four if confirmed.
[15] (about=Yara, episodic, t14 @2025-04-21T18:55:00) ha! pub planning meeting next wed update, proposal got partially refused, third version coming in three months. small win
agent_answer:
B. Walter

Walter’s reaction signalled less than full agreement: he said the proposed structure “mirrors what we used in 1998 … It worked then,” but then added, “I have one suggested amendment, will send by email.” That caveat shows he was not fully endorsing the protocol as settled — he was already flagging a modification he wanted to make.

query:
The chat settled on holding the AGM at Diane's front garden, with Henry chairing. Most members responded warmly or neutrally. Whose response in that moment carried a different quality, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Owen
B. Joel
C. Bex
D. Marek
context:
[1] (about=Marek, episodic, t14 @2025-04-21T18:37:00) punch is fine. but listen, an AGM in the GARDEN should at least have music. quietly. just saying. 🎶
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t14 @2025-04-21T18:39:00) Marek, quietly. Lovely word, that. D
[3] (about=Aisling, episodic, t10 @2025-04-07T18:58:00) lol the Hartleys' guests are now diane's redemption arc 😂 brilliant tbh
[4] (about=Bex, episodic, t10 @2025-04-07T18:52:00) DIANE getting pastries from the strangers!! who are you 😂
[5] (about=Constance, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:08:00) I do think it's a shame. Forty-one years on this street and it has never felt this transient. I must say I share Diane's view entirely.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t18 @2025-05-05T18:57:00) AGM confirmed: Saturday May 17, 2pm, Diane's front garden.
[7] (about=Greg, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:14:00) no garden burning this year. council letter went out march. ill remind anyone who forgets
[8] (about=Henry, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:04:00) Evening all. Numbers are tidy this month, nothing alarming. Will post the spreadsheet link after Diane has finished her items.
[9] (about=Mei, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:09:00) Planters are in, soil due Wednesday. Will tidy them on Saturday morning so they look right for the AGM.
[10] (about=Priya, episodic, t18 @2025-05-05T19:13:00) Note: hayfever season starting. Three children on the street with mild asthma. The planters are fine, just worth noting if anyone burns garden waste.
[11] (about=Yara, episodic, t0 @2025-03-03T19:27:00) i'll come! has anyone else noticed the magnolias on the lower bend are about to go? second time in three years they've bloomed by mid-March, ha! the climate is doing things
agent_answer:
D. Marek

When the group settled on Diane's front garden, Marek's response stood out because it wasn't a warm acceptance or a neutral acknowledgment — it was a playful, slightly teasing suggestion:

"punch is fine. but listen, an AGM in the GARDEN should at least have music. quietly. just saying. 🎶"

The tell is in the phrasing and tone: "should at least have music" implies the decision is incomplete, "quietly" is a sly constraint, and "just saying 🎶" plus the music emoji mark it as lighthearted but distinctly off-key compared to everyone else's warm/neutral reception. Diane even picked up on "quietly" ("Lovely word, that"), showing the remark registered as a different kind of contribution.

The other options don't fit: Owen and Joel have no record of responding at all, and Bex's comment was about Diane getting pastries from strangers, not about the AGM location.
